title: Face Mask, Shield Mask, Respiratory Mask Testing
description: ITC INDIA is doing the Safety Testing for Mask/Face Shield/ respirator ANSI Z 87.1, ASTM 1862, CPSC-CS-191-53 and MIL-STD 36954C

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: ITC INDIA is Capable of Testing all type of Surgical Mask/Face Shield / N95 respirator Mask for the safety as per ANSI Z 87.1, ASTM 1862, CPSC-CS-191-53 and MIL-STD 36954C etc. N 95 Mask: N95 mask or N95 respirator is used for filtration that meets the requirement of (NIOSH) N95 standard of air filtration, meaning that it filters at least 95% of airborne particles. Face Shield: Is a mask, generally made of plastic material that protects the tissue which secretes mucus of the eyes, nose, and mouth during the patient-care. Surgical Mask: Medical mask is intended by health professionals during surgery and during nursing to catch the bacteria shed in liquid droplets and aerosols from the wearer’s mouth and nose.

sections.heading: Why Tested Mask Must used?
bullets: Today heavy demand of Mask/Face Shield/ respirator etc. everybody knows it’s across the globe. So a Tested Mask/Shield Should be use for someone life.

Due to shortage of Mask/Face Shield/ respirator etc. Manufacturing or exporting the Mask/Face Shield/ respirator etc. Without seeing the safety expects as per ANSI Z 87.1, ASTM 1862, CPSC-CS-191-53 and MIL-STD 36954C.
ANSI Z 87.1, ASTM 1862, CPSC-CS-191-53 and MIL-STD 36954C standards is required for Particular requirements for basic safety.
It’s help to improve the Quality of the product.
